open3dApp.downsampling.linux.Downsample_module module

This module provides utilities regarding the Linux kernel module scan.ko.

class open3dApp.downsampling.linux.Downsample_module.DownsampleModule(module_name='scan', device_path='/dev/scan')[source]

Bases: LinuxModule

Configures and runs the Linux kernel module called scan for downsampling the scans. You cannot read kernel logs nor use the method get_info as they require admin privileges.

open3dApp.downsampling.linux.module_init module

This module should be run separately, still having the access to the scan.c and Makefile files. Preferably, not moved. It contains methods to initiate the scan module, which is a Linux kernel module with a character device. This module is used for the downsampling algorithm.
